command:
bash -c output="$PWD/$0"; directory="$1"; shift; echo started > "$output/exit_status"
cd "$directory" || { echo 111 > "$output/exit_status"; exit 111; }
"$@" > >(tee "$output/stdout") 2> >(tee "$output/stderr" >&2)
status=$?; echo "$status" > "$output/exit_status"; exit "$status" monitor/20/20261007T205001-squeue /home/cb239 squeue --me --format=%.10i %15P %40j %10u %.2t %.10M %.6D %.2C %.10m %30R
